method: Mobile native-touch engineering fixtures. Starting poses, active phase, objective selection and one collected state are arranged; no played recoveries or mission win. Route lengths, swept physics, real input crossings, renderer rays and roof rain checked. Two profiles additionally stage a hunter with firing suppressed to isolate live pursuit through the aperture. One forced-asset-failure case checks fallback.

checks: four apertures, expected renderer mode and matching structural colliders
north-side route detours are short and every preview segment is clear
actual geometry and capsules leave the exit clear but retain cheek cover
native forward walking crosses outward and back without jump or dash
a live hunter pursues through the service opening
rear opening has clear player/enemy/mesh paths, jump headroom and retained pier cover
normal forward touch from the baseline memory pose exits north without jump/dash
native jump and phase cross the rear frame with swept clearance
live hunter crosses the new rear opening in normal animation frames
roof shelter remains authoritative and masks below-canopy rain

pursuit.method: Arranged hunter/player poses; firing suppressed on fixture actor; normal animation-frame AI movement, no manual simulation advance.

rearPursuit.method: Arranged hunter/player starts, fixture firing suppressed; sampled actual animation-frame pursuit and interpolated rear-wall crossing
